name: tranquilo-poc-api
description: Dependency manifest for the /api serverless functions (share-link meta tags, OG image generation, collection submission email, analytics ingestion) plus dev-only test tooling (Vitest) and the Vite/TypeScript toolchain for the frontend (see CONVENTIONS.md). The live deploy serves Vite's multi-page `dist/` build (vercel.json's outputDirectory/buildCommand) -- `bun run build` bundles index.html and every pages/*.html entry, each referencing its .ts sources directly. Vercel installs `dependencies` automatically at deploy time for the /api functions; `devDependencies` never ships. `prisma` is migrations-only -- schema.prisma/prisma.config.ts drive `bun run db:migrate:*`, but there is no @prisma/client and no query builder; every actual query stays raw SQL via @neondatabase/serverless.

scripts.build: bun run generate-config && bun run generate-env && bun x vite build
scripts.preview: bun run build && bun x vite preview
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun x playwright test
scripts.test:all: bun run build && bun x vitest run && bun x playwright test
